rules.title: Unmonitored Servers Right-Sizing Headroom Risk
rules.mitigation: Apply conservative right-sizing headroom band (20%) and conduct targeted workload profiling prior to cutover.

rules.title: Legacy / End-of-Life Operating System Risk
rules.mitigation: Enroll legacy Windows Server/SQL Server in Extended Security Updates (ESU) on Azure, or prioritize in-place upgrade.

rules.title: Single Region Deployment Without Active DR
rules.mitigation: Implement Azure Site Recovery (ASR) paired-region replication for tier-1 business-critical applications.

rules.title: Database Replatforming Cutover Complexity
rules.mitigation: Perform pre-migration schema assessment with Azure Data Studio / DMA and conduct dry-run cutover.

rules.title: Cross-Wave Affinity & Latency Risk
rules.mitigation: Revalidate stale dependencies with packet-level inspection and group tightly coupled servers into identical wave.

rules.title: Unanswered Discovery Questionnaire Requirements
rules.mitigation: Issue discovery questionnaire to business stakeholders to confirm RPO, RTO, and compliance scope.
